title: SA/814/1999 of SMT.RAGHUBERI and OTHERS Vs VED PAL and OTHERS

paras.text:
Modification No. 609 of 2014
IN
SA No. 1017 of 2001
Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Mr. Sharad Sharma, Senior
Advocate assisted by Mr. Pradeep
Chamilay, Advocate present for the
appellants.
 Mr. A.K. Sharma, Advocate present
for respondents/applicants.
 The modification application moved
by the respondents is totally misconceived.
There is no ground for review/modify the
order dated 04.01.2011, as during the
pendency of the present matter, the
numbers of all the plots have been changed
and in case the respondent has any
grievance, he may move application under
Section 152 C.P.C before the appropriate
court.
 The modification application is
hereby rejected.
